summary: Re-ran the 390x844 mobile regression and backend medicine flow. Today loading, add validation/save, dose completion, History persistence/filter controls, Settings switches, Medicines search/edit navigation, overflow, and runtime console checks passed.
action_items: Set EXPO_BACKEND_URL in the test shell or backend test fixture before running pytest; the current test file intentionally reads that variable and otherwise reports a local MissingSchema setup error.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts now supports Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl, EXPO_BACKEND_URL, and EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in the required order.
No mocked APIs detected; all tested flows used the live preview backend.
Expo logs include a non-blocking React Native DevTools electron sandbox warning, but Metro bundled and the app rendered without runtime errors.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_Iteration2 through the UI and left it in preview data for the final edit-navigation assertion; backend TEST_regression_medicine was cleaned up by the regression fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested follow-up controls and API fallback behavior were exercised successfully at 390x844. The only failed command was pytest without EXPO_BACKEND_URL exported; rerunning with the documented variable passed both tests.
rca_of_issue: The initial pytest invocation failed before making a request because backend/tests/test_medicines_regression.py reads EXPO_BACKEND_URL directly while the shell did not export it. This is test invocation configuration, not an API failure; supplying EXPO_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env produced 2/2 passing tests.
